theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 17 群

items.pos: adj. 見多識廣的；知情的
items.colloc: informed decision 明智的決定 | keep someone informed 隨時告知某人
items.distinct: knowledgeable 知識淵博的 | educated 受過教育的
ex: An informed consumer makes better purchasing choices.
見多識廣的消費者能做出更好的購買選擇。
Please keep me informed about the project status.
請隨時讓我知道專案的最新進展。
We need to make an informed decision today.
我們今天需要做出明智的決定。

items.colloc: initial stage 初步階段 | initial investment 初始投資
items.distinct: original 最初的（強調源頭）| primary 主要的
ex: The initial reaction to the proposal was positive.
對該提案的初步反應很正面。
Initial reports indicate a significant rise in sales.
初步報告顯示銷售額顯著成長。
Our initial plan needs some minor adjustments now.
我們最初的計畫現在需要些微調整。

items.colloc: health insurance 健康保險 | insurance policy 保險單
items.distinct: assurance 保證（保險的一種）| premium 保險費
ex: The company offers comprehensive health insurance plans.
公司提供完善的健康保險方案。
You should review your insurance policy annually.
你應該每年審視一次保險單。
Does the price include travel insurance coverage?
這個價格包含旅遊保險嗎？

items.colloc: have no intention of 沒有…的意圖 | with the intention of 懷著…的意圖
items.distinct: purpose 目的 | plan 計畫
ex: It is not my intention to cause any delay.
我無意造成任何延誤。
The company announced its intention to expand overseas.
公司宣布了向海外擴張的計畫。
He has no intention of resigning from the post.
他並沒有辭去該職位的打算。

items.pos: n. 興趣；利益；利息 | v. 使…感興趣
items.colloc: show interest in 對…感興趣 | rate of interest 利率
items.distinct: benefit 好處 | hobby 嗜好
ex: Investors have shown great interest in this startup.
投資者對這家新創公司表現出極大興趣。
The bank offers a very low interest rate.
銀行提供了很低的利率。
This new feature will interest our target audience.
這項新功能會吸引我們的目標客群。

items.pos: n. 面試；訪談 | v. 面試；採訪
items.colloc: job interview 求職面試 | conduct an interview 進行面試
items.distinct: interviewer 面試官 | interviewee 面試者
ex: She prepared well for the job interview yesterday.
她昨天為求職面試做了充分準備。
We will interview three candidates this afternoon.
我們今天下午將面試三位候選人。
The candidate arrived early for the final interview.
這位候選人很早就到達參加最終面試。

items.colloc: the vast majority 絕大多數 | majority vote 多數票
items.distinct: minority 少數 | most 大多數（形容詞）
ex: The majority of staff members support the policy.
大多數員工支持這項政策。
The majority vote decided the new office location.
多數票決定了新的辦公室地點。
A majority of the board members agreed today.
董事會成員今天有過半數表示同意。

items.colloc: take measurements 進行測量 | accurate measurement 精確測量
items.distinct: dimension 體積、面積 | gauge 測量儀器
ex: The technician took measurements of the equipment.
技術人員對設備進行了測量。
Precise measurement is essential for this project.
精確的測量對這個專案至關重要。
Please verify all measurements before cutting wood.
請在切割木材前核對所有尺寸。

items.colloc: non-profit organization 非營利組織 | international organization 國際組織
items.distinct: company 公司 | association 協會
ex: She works for a large international organization.
她在一家大型國際組織工作。
Effective organization is key to team success.
有效的組織能力是團隊成功的關鍵。
Our organization aims to improve workplace safety.
我們的組織旨在改善工作場所安全。

items.pos: n. 大綱；輪廓 | v. 概述
items.colloc: brief outline 簡要大綱 | provide an outline 提供大綱
items.distinct: draft 草稿 | summary 摘要
ex: The manager provided an outline of the strategy.
經理概述了這項策略的大綱。
Please outline your goals for the coming quarter.
請概述您接下來一季的目標。
This document serves as an outline for training.
這份文件作為培訓的大綱。

items.pos: n. 包裹；套餐 | v. 包裝
items.colloc: software package 軟體套件 | compensation package 薪酬配套
items.distinct: parcel 包裹（郵寄）| bundle 綑綁
ex: The delivery service dropped off the package.
快遞服務人員送達了那個包裹。
We offer a competitive total compensation package.
我們提供極具競爭力的整體薪酬配套。
They will package the items for overseas shipping.
他們會把商品包裝好以利海外寄送。

items.colloc: job performance 工作表現 | improve performance 提升績效
items.distinct: result 結果 | achievement 成就
ex: His performance during the quarter was excellent.
他本季度的表現非常出色。
We need to evaluate the team's overall performance.
我們需要評估團隊的整體績效。
High performance leads to faster career advancement.
優異的績效能帶來更快的職業晉升。

items.pos: adj. 令人愉快的；討人喜歡的
items.colloc: aesthetically pleasing 美觀的 | pleasing result 令人滿意的結果
items.distinct: pleasant 舒適的 | pleased 高興的
ex: The new office design is quite aesthetically pleasing.
新的辦公室設計相當美觀。
We received a pleasing response from the client.
我們收到了客戶令人滿意的回應。
His pleasing personality makes him a great teammate.
他討人喜歡的個性使他成為很棒的隊友。

items.pos: n. 稱讚；讚揚 | v. 稱讚
items.colloc: win praise 獲得讚揚 | high praise 高度讚揚
items.distinct: compliment 恭維 | flatter 阿諛奉承
ex: The CEO had high praise for the marketing team.
執行長對行銷團隊給予高度讚揚。
She deserves praise for her hard work today.
她今天的努力工作值得稱讚。
Everyone rushed to praise his innovative solution.
每個人都紛紛稱讚他創新的解決方案。

items.colloc: personal preference 個人偏好 | express a preference 表達偏好
items.distinct: choice 選擇 | priority 優先權
ex: Do you have a preference for any specific time?
您對特定的時間有偏好嗎？
We considered the client's preferences for the project.
我們考量了客戶對該專案的偏好。
Personal preference often influences our buying decisions.
個人偏好通常會影響我們的購買決策。

items.colloc: give a presentation 做簡報 | presentation skills 簡報技巧
items.distinct: speech 演講 | demonstration 示範
ex: He is preparing a presentation for the board.
他正在為董事會準備一份簡報。
Your presentation skills have improved significantly this year.
你今年的簡報技巧進步顯著。
The final presentation will take place on Friday.
最終的簡報將於星期五進行。

items.colloc: preserve resources 保存資源 | preserve the environment 維護環境
items.distinct: conserve 節約 | maintain 維持
ex: We must preserve these documents for future reference.
我們必須保存這些文件以備未來參考。
The company aims to preserve its strong reputation.
公司旨在維護其良好的聲譽。
Strict measures were taken to preserve the park.
當局採取了嚴格措施來保護該公園。

items.colloc: prevent accidents 防止意外 | prevent from doing 阻止做…
items.distinct: avoid 避免 | stop 停止
ex: Safety gear helps prevent injuries at the site.
安全裝備有助於預防工地受傷。
Nothing can prevent us from achieving our goals.
沒有什麼能阻止我們達成目標。
Proper maintenance helps prevent equipment from failing.
適當的維護有助於防止設備故障。

items.colloc: top priority 最高優先事項 | give priority to 給予…優先權
items.distinct: importance 重要性 | preference 偏好
ex: Our top priority is to finish the project.
我們的最高優先事項是完成該專案。
You should give priority to urgent customer requests.
你應該優先處理緊急的客戶需求。
Work-life balance is a priority for most employees.
工作與生活平衡是多數員工的首要考量。

items.colloc: proceed with 繼續進行 | proceed to the next step 前往下一步
items.distinct: continue 繼續 | advance 前進
ex: We will proceed with the plan next week.
我們下週將會繼續進行該計畫。
Please proceed to the check-in counter now.
請現在前往報到櫃檯。
How should we proceed with this legal matter?
我們該如何處理這件法律事務？
